shortDescription: Manage Extents on VPLEX Storage Object

options.name: debug
options.description: To specify whether to have debug statements from vplexapi in log file or not

options.name: extent_name
options.description: Name of the extent Mutually exclusive with storage_volume_name and storage_volume_id

options.name: new_extent_name
options.description: New name of the extent for rename operation

options.name: ssl_ca_cert
options.description: SSL CA certificate file (.pem format) provided by the user to verify SSL

options.name: state
options.description: Defines whether the extent should exist or not

options.name: storage_volume_id
options.description: ID of the storage volume on which the extent will be created Mutually exclusive with storage_volume_name and extent_name

options.name: storage_volume_name
options.description: Name of the storage volume on which the extent will be created Mutually exclusive with storage_volume_id and extent_name

options.name: verifycert
options.description: boolean variable to specify whether to validate SSL certificate or not. True - indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. False - indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.

options.name: vplex_timeout
options.description: the network connectivity timeout value to connect to VPLEX host in seconds

options.name: vplexhost
options.description: IP or FQDN of the VPLEX host

options.name: vplexpassword
options.description: the password of the VPLEX host.
